skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Analyze the theoretical foundations explaining the origins of economic growth.
Apply theoretical models to real-world scenarios to explain differences in economic growth rates among countries over time.
Evaluate the role of physical capital accumulation, human capital, and population growth in economic growth.
Assess income disparities between countries through explanations of differences in production factor accumulation and factors affecting this process.
Analyze the importance of productivity growth in explaining differences in income levels and growth rates between countries.
Examine differences in technology and factors determining the formation of advanced technology.
Evaluate the role of public policy and open economies in promoting growth and improving economic efficiency.
